rv.q: This show feels more like a message than an encounter.
How To Win Against History is an exciting new musical with a fascinating story.
For How to Win Against History remains a glittery gem for fans of campy musical extravaganzas, packing oodles of heart, laughs and visual pizzazz.
The show is likely to improve through its run as the team settles into their run, but for a show so highly praised in the past, it did not live up to its fabulous hype.

cn.t: Critics find this musical biography of forgotten aristocrat Henry Cyril Paget witty and well-performed, with brilliant songs and fabulous costumes, though some feel the eccentric subject remains enigmatic and unlikable.
